verdict.rationale: Agents can create an order through documented protocol calls: the Agent Toolkit and MCP server expose `create_order`, and Store Sync's cart API (POST /merchant-cart, get cart) lets agents "create and manage shopping carts" via PayPal Shopping Cart. ACP and UCP checkout-session paths add further protocol coverage. Caveats: PayPal's service, not the agent, calls the merchant cart endpoints, and Store Sync access is form-gated and limited to US physical goods. missing for 10: an explicitly documented update-cart/update-order call (only create and get endpoints are crawled; "manage" implies but does not document updates), independent or hands-on corroboration of agent cart creation and updates.
